diffs.diff: header pin 10: part says G, datasheet reading says RX
diffs.evidence: The LOLIN OLED 0.66 shield v2.1.0 schematic (image-only PDF) numbers header P1 around the board, 9=5V, 10=GND, 11=D4/2, 12=D3/0, 13=SDA/D2/4, 14=SCL/D1/5, 15=RX, 16=TX, and the Fritzing part for this shield lists its connectors in that same order (RST..3V3, then 5V, G, D4, D3, D2, D1, RX, TX), e.g. '<connector type="female" id="g" name="G">'; the second reading listed the right-hand row top-down from TX, which is a different numbering of the same pins, not a different pinout.
